description: Save one word from the exact supplied passage to the connected MTW Backpack ONLY when the learner explicitly asks to save it. Re-inspects the word through MTW; for an ambiguous meaning, pass only the sense ID the learner selected from the offered choices. Preserve text, context and title. Use one operation UUID for this save and reuse it after a lost reply. Does not mark the word known, grade recall, or save the entire passage.

destination.description: Destination returned by get_mandarin_account. A consistency check, never account authority.

text.description: Exact original Mandarin passage, including punctuation and whitespace; at most 4,096 Unicode code points. Do not translate or rewrite it.

name: save_mandarin_word
title: Save a chosen Mandarin word to Backpack
